text.text_excerpt: Loving this places happy hour. Last night was $4 red fish tacos and margaritas. Tonight was half priced grilled oysters and house wines. $8/dozen. Can't wait to check out tonight's happy hour!

We stopped in here several times while staying at this Marriott. The staff was always rather friendly and the management was great and very helpful. They have a nice selection of wines, as well as all the other adult beverages one could ask for. They have a nice menu loaded with many items to nosh on while sitting & sipping. Only issue is I wish they stayed open later than they do, as many times after a night out on the town, we came back to enjoy a night cap here, but barely made last call. Their pizza was VERY tasty! The lounge is huge and does a nice job accommodating many people, it stayed packed the entire time we were here. The staff did a very nice job keeping it clean as well. Whe...

This is located in the Marriott. I ordered their shrimp tempura and softshelled crab rolls. MmMmMm. Almost a week without eating rice definitely had its toll on me as an Asian person. It was so good. I actually missed rice. So Asian!! Even I can't believe it. Wow. Each order only came with 4 pieces, but it actually was really compacted with rice. I regret getting two orders because I was greedy. One would have been fine for me. Service was not bad at all. The prices are a bit expensive, but its not too bad. Rice. Yum. Specialty Rolls. MmMmMm
